summary: Integrate graph-neutral conflict repair before bounded graph handling and fix its regression fixtures.

replay.detail: Graph-neutral operations retain their inline canonical registry repair. Reader discovery fences only graph-projecting or mixed operation histories, so a neutral-only conflict does not suppress an unrelated legitimate replay. Unproven automatic replay remains fenced by the driver.

rules.detail: Canonical registry and graph fold semantics are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The runtime classifies graph-neutral kinds for reader-side conflict discovery. Direct low-level replay guard decisions remain intact for uncommitted ranges not yet scanned.

recovery.detail: Existing bounded refold and explicit degraded-repair behavior remains in place.

downtime.detail: Also corrects the owned-set regression fixture's missing policy field so test builds compile.
